source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official STAC selection, anonymous S3 dataset, bbox filter and RecordBatchReader implementation.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: record_batch_reader prepares an anonymous us-west-2 S3 dataset, applies bbox overlap predicates, optionally narrows files through STAC collections.parquet, and streams non-empty batches.
The package exports record_batch_reader and geodataframe directly from overturemaps.core.
